main.description: Pushes one of the requesting user's social.colibri.beta.actor.spaceNotification records to the AppView, so it takes effect immediately instead of waiting for a sync notification. The client writes or deletes the record in its own personal space first, then calls this.

level.description: The new level. Absent together with removeLevel returns the community to the global level.

removeLevel.description: Removes the community's level so it follows the global one. Ignored when level is present.

preferences.description: The requesting user's settings, after the update.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Neither level nor removeLevel is present, or level does not hold an allowed value.
